findings.finding: The spec says INFRA-648's query lists a both-column ask only under its block artifact; the text check at marks.go:775 makes it listed under neither.
findings.answer: Corrected in the plan ('under neither'); the architect confirmed and asked for the correction (Envoy 2cf4887d).

findings.finding: Listing the mark under the block's document too disagrees with refreshAnchors, rejectUnindexedTableMarks and mutation.go, which read the anchor's artifact only; a mark kept there would never be refreshed or released.
findings.answer: Sent to the architect, who changed the design to anchor-only; recorded as a spec departure; the B half of the test is dropped.

findings.finding: The acceptance test can pass vacuously: sweepUnrecordedMarks logs and keeps every mark when recordedMarkRefs errors.
findings.answer: A1 adds an unrecorded control mark that must be swept, uses the held-clock pattern, and has two negative controls (INFRA-648 predicate, coalesce-only predicate).

findings.finding: Fixture pitfalls: foreign key on block_artifact_id, asks_one_owner, insertAnchoredAsk's fixed id and event, ask-block reconciliation retracting an open ask whose block is absent.
findings.answer: B is a real document; insertAnchoredAsk on A then update block_artifact_id = B with block_id null, which every block reader skips; issue_key DOC-1 as the helper writes it.

findings.finding: No existing index reaches asks by the anchor's artifact when block_artifact_id is set; asks_anchor_block_id_idx is partial on anchor->>'block_id'.
findings.answer: Migration 0137 adds a partial index on (anchor->>'artifact_id')::uuid where anchor is not null; asks_anchor_artifact stays for graph_edges.

specDepartures.spec: List an ask's recorded mark under both artifacts it names (anchor's and block's); the test finds the mark kept on each document. The Outcome also says INFRA-648's query lists a both-column ask only under its block artifact.
specDepartures.plan: Anchor-only: an ask's mark is recorded on the document its anchor names, whatever block_artifact_id holds, through a new partial index on (anchor->>'artifact_id')::uuid; the test checks the anchor's document only. The Outcome's claim is corrected: INFRA-648's query lists such an ask under neither document.
specDepartures.evidence: marks.go:775 keeps anchor->>'artifact_id' = $1 beside the coalesce, so the both-column ask is dropped under both documents; refreshAnchors (marks.go:464), rejectUnindexedTableMarks (edits.go:676-680) and mutation.go:914/:941 read the anchor's artifact only. The INFRA-512 architect decided anchor-only on 2026-10-28 22:00Z (Envoy message 2cf4887d0a44604fa37cf1e81ea9baaa, reply to the planner's 5ea13e63).

outcome.scope: summary: Outcome's 'listed only under its block artifact' and 'list an ask's recorded mark under both artifacts' become 'listed under neither' and 'under the anchor's document'; acceptance: the first test finds the mark kept on the anchor's document only, the block document's half dropped
